--- Page 1 (Beckerman_22a) --- Dear Falks and Ruth: Wrote you two days ago. But today was a busy day when all the very delayed air mail arrived. I got about half dozen. And me for you. I've read that you folks I have been told to use air mail rather than air mail to insure better service. Air mail has been coming in very poorly. Spent the evening tonight writing room - Had a whole draw of canned goods that I accumulated from my Christmas packages. Tonight I opened up a few cans and had a supper of meat spread, smoked fish, olives and some cold beer. Pretty nice. And have been reading some books that Evelyn Withkind sent me. Send you more - apthes crew send you - me for excuse the jargons. Let me know how it comes out. I'll be awaiting for these words. --- Page 2 (Beckerman_22b) --- I thanks so very much for sending them. And also to [illegible] because I'm almost sure that she supplied them. Am awaiting something fun Abe. Am trying to get up his way. Nothing definite yet. It's [illegible] again tonight. I told you we live in what used to be a park. The huge Brisbane General Hospital is just on the opposite side and sometimes when I take a look at it, it almost looks like our house at night. It's the biggest building in Brisbane. We're in tonight. Well unto again soon. Love Jack
